modes.name_en: Principle Resides in Desire Method (Li Within Yu)
modes.definition_zh: 理也者，情之不爽失也。天理不在人心之外高悬，而存在于人的自然情欲的恰当实现之中。凡事为皆有于欲，无欲则无为矣；有欲而后有为，有为而归于至当不易之谓理。此法把道德的根据从超验的「理」拉回到活生生的「欲」，主张体民之情、遂民之欲，反对以天理压制人欲。
modes.definition_en: Principle (li) is precisely the condition in which feeling (qing) does not err. Tianli (Heavenly Principle) is not suspended outside the human mind but resides in the proper fulfillment of natural desires. Where there is no desire there is no action; where there is desire there is action, and action attaining what is fitting and unchanging is called li. This method grounds morality in living desire rather than transcendent principle, advocating empathy for people's feelings and fulfillment of their needs.
process_zh: 承认欲是人的自然本性，是行为的原动力（凡事为皆有于欲） → 拒绝把理与欲对立起来的二元框架 → 以『情之不爽失』为标准：己之情通乎人之情 → 在满足欲望的过程中寻求其恰当分寸，即理之所在
process_en: Acknowledge desire as human nature and the spring of action → reject the dualist framework opposing principle to desire → take 'feeling without error' as the standard: my feelings connect to others' → seek the fitting measure in fulfilling desire; there lies principle
modes.key_quote_zh: 理也者，情之不爽失也。……有欲而后有为，有为而归于至当不易之谓理。
modes.key_quote_en: Principle is precisely the condition in which feeling does not err. … Where there is desire there is action, and action attaining what is fitting and unchanging is called principle.
representative_cases_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·理》：「理也者，情之不爽失也。……有欲而后有为，有为而归……」——理存于欲法的典据来源
modern_applications_zh: 人本主义管理与制度设计
公共政策中的需求导向思维
对伪道德绑架的识别与反制
modern_applications_en: Humanistic management and institutional design
Needs-oriented thinking in public policy
Identifying and countering pseudo-moral coercion

modes.name_en: Critique of Killing by Principle Method (Deconstructing Moral Tyranny)
modes.definition_zh: 人死于法，犹有怜之者；死于理，其谁怜之！尊者以理责卑，长者以理责幼，贵者以理责贱，虽失谓之顺；卑幼贱以理争之，虽得谓之逆。此法揭示当「理」被权力垄断后如何异化为压迫工具——上位者以抽象名义行具体迫害，且受害者无处申辩。
modes.definition_en: 'One who dies by law still receives pity; who pities one killed by Principle?' Elders, superiors, and the powerful use 'Principle' to blame the young, the inferior, and the lowly — even when they are wrong they are called compliant; when the lowly argue by Principle and are right, they are called rebellious. This method exposes how 'Principle', once monopolized by power, degenerates into an instrument of oppression that leaves victims no recourse.
process_zh: 识别以抽象名义（理、大局、传统）包装的具体压迫 → 检查该名义的适用是否单向：只约束下位者 → 追问受害者的申辩通道是否存在（死于理其谁怜之） → 把批判从道德义愤升级为结构分析：谁在定义理，谁被理定义
process_en: Identify concrete oppression packaged under abstract names (principle, the greater good, tradition) → check whether the name applies one-way, binding only subordinates → ask whether the victim has any channel of appeal → upgrade critique from moral indignation to structural analysis: who defines the principle, who is defined by it
modes.key_quote_zh: 人死于法，犹有怜之者；死于理，其谁怜之！
modes.key_quote_en: One who dies by law still has those who pity him; one who dies by 'principle'—who would pity him!
representative_cases_zh: 《孟子字义疏证》/《与某书》：「人死于法，犹有怜之者；死于理，其谁怜之！……」——以理杀人批判法的典据来源
modern_applications_zh: 识别职场与家庭中的以道德名义PUA
对制度性话语权力的批判分析
舆论审判与网暴的结构性透视
modern_applications_en: Detecting moralized PUA in workplaces and families
Critical analysis of institutional discursive power
A structural reading of trial by public opinion

modes.name_en: From Words to the Way Method (Philology as the Path to Principle)
modes.definition_zh: 经之至者道也，所以明道者其词也，所以成词者字也。由字以通其词，由词以通其道，必有渐。训诂明而后义理明，义理不凭空立，必附丽于文字的准确理解。此法把哲学重建置于语言考证的坚实基础上，使每一义理判断都可追溯到字义的证据链。
modes.definition_en: 'What is ultimate in the classics is the Way; what clarifies the Way are the words; what forms the words are the characters.' From characters one understands words, from words one reaches the Way — each step by degrees. Only when philology is clear can moral principle be clear: philosophy must be rebuilt on the solid ground of textual and linguistic evidence, with every doctrinal claim traceable to an evidential chain of word-meanings.
modes.source_chapter: 《与是仲明论学书》/《尔雅注疏笺补序》
process_zh: 从最基础的语言单位（字、音、训）入手 → 逐级上升：由字通词，由词通经义 → 以字义证据链检验义理诠释，凡无据者不立 → 用明确的语言学结论重构哲学命题（如以《说文》《尔雅》证「理」之本义）
process_en: Start from the basic units of language (characters, sounds, glosses) → ascend stepwise: from characters to words, from words to classical meaning → test every interpretation of principle against a chain of lexical evidence; admit nothing without basis → rebuild philosophical claims on settled linguistic conclusions
modes.key_quote_zh: 由字以通其词，由词以通其道。……训诂明而后义理明。
modes.key_quote_en: From characters, reach the words; from words, reach the Way. … Only when philological exegesis is clear can moral principle be clear.
representative_cases_zh: 《与是仲明论学书》/《尔雅注疏笺补序》：「由字以通其词，由词以通其道。……训诂明而后义理明……」——由词通道法的典据来源
modern_applications_zh: 概念史与术语考证方法
法律与合同中的语义精确化
把大问题分解为可验证的小证据单元
modern_applications_en: Conceptual history and terminological philology
Semantic precision in law and contracts
Decomposing big questions into verifiable units of evidence

modes.name_en: Analytic Discrimination Method (Li as Differentiated Detail)
modes.definition_zh: 理者，察之而几微必区以别之名也，是故谓之分理。理不是笼统的玄谈，而是对事物之间细微差别的精确区分：肌理、腠理、文理，皆是条分缕析之谓。得其分则有条而不紊，谓之条理。此法确立了一种分析性的理性观——真理在细节的分辨之中，不在笼统的断言之中。
modes.definition_en: 'Li is the name for what, when examined, must be differentiated in its finest details — hence called fenli (divided principle).' Li is not vague metaphysical talk but precise discrimination of subtle differences among things: the grain of muscle, the lines of skin, the pattern of text are all cases of ordered analysis. This method establishes an analytic rationality: truth resides in the discrimination of details, not in sweeping assertions.
process_zh: 拒绝先验地宣布笼统结论（理不是玄想） → 对对象做逐层分类，识别其内部的细微差别 → 在每一个分辨点上求证（必区以别） → 把差异组织为条理，得出可以指认、可以检验的分理
process_en: Refuse to announce sweeping conclusions a priori → classify the object layer by layer, marking its fine internal distinctions → seek evidence at each point of discrimination → organize differences into an articulable, testable order
modes.key_quote_zh: 理者，察之而几微必区以别之名也。
modes.key_quote_en: Principle is the name for that which, on close examination of its subtlest details, must be discriminated into distinct particulars.
representative_cases_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·理》：「理者，察之而几微必区以别之名也。……」——分理分析法的典据来源
modern_applications_zh: 定性研究中的细粒度分析
产品与流程的颗粒度优化
从「讲道理」到「分道理」的论证升级
modern_applications_en: Fine-grained analysis in qualitative research
Granularity optimization of products and processes
Upgrading argument from 'reasoning in general' to 'discriminating particulars'

modes.name_en: Blood-Qi and Mind-Knowing Method (Naturalistic Theory of Human Nature)
modes.definition_zh: 性者，分于阴阳五行以为血气、心知、品物者也。人的性由血气（形体的欲求能力）与心知（认知能力）构成，与万物同源于气化，只有等差之别而无超绝之分。血气资饮寒以养，心知之自然通过学习而扩充，德性资于学问，进而神明。此法把人性论建立在自然主义与可塑性的基础上，反对先验的「义理之性」。
modes.definition_en: Human nature consists of blood-qi (xueqi — the body's capacity of desire) and mind-knowing (xinzhi — the capacity of cognition), both allotted from yin-yang and the five phases; humans differ from other beings in degree, not in transcendence. Blood-qi is nourished by food and warmth; mind-knowing is expanded through learning — 'virtue is supplied by learning' — until the spirit illuminates. This method grounds human nature in naturalism and plasticity, rejecting the a priori 'righteous nature' of Neo-Confucianism.
process_zh: 承认人的双重能力：欲望能力（血气）与认知能力（心知） → 认识到两者皆需滋养：血气资饮食，心知资学问 → 通过学习把心的自然状态提升为神明（明察）状态 → 以可扩展的心知驾驭可节制的血气，而非以禁欲压制欲望
process_en: Recognize the twin capacities: desire (blood-qi) and cognition (mind-knowing) → note that both need nourishment: blood-qi by sustenance, mind-knowing by learning → raise the mind from its natural state to luminous clarity through study → let the enlarged knowing govern the restrained desires, rather than suppressing desire by asceticism
modes.key_quote_zh: 血气资饮食以养，心知于前世之开明，资于学问以进于神明。
modes.key_quote_en: Blood and qi are nourished by food and drink; the mind's knowing, nourished by learning, advances toward luminous clarity.
representative_cases_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·性》/《原善》：「血气资饮食以养，心知于前世之开明，资于学问以进于……」——血气心知法的典据来源
modern_applications_zh: 成长型人格与终身学习观
身心一体化健康观
对人性先验论的批判与教育设计
modern_applications_en: Growth mindset and lifelong learning
An integrated view of physical and mental health
Critiquing a priori theories of human nature in educational design

modes.name_en: Uncovering Obscuration and Removing Self-Interest Method
modes.definition_zh: 天下大乱之源有二：曰蔽，曰私。蔽生于知之失——人之患在好为师，以己见为理而人从之；私生于欲之失——以一己之欲为天下之公。去私莫如强恕，解蔽莫如学。此法诊断认知错误的两大病灶：一是自我中心导致以私为公，二是认知局限导致以蔽为明。
modes.definition_en: 'The sources of great disorder in the world are two: obscuration (bi) and self-interest (si).' Bi arises from the failure of knowing — the human failing of loving to be a teacher, taking one's own view as Principle; si arises from the failure of desire — taking one's private wish as the public good. 'To remove self-interest, nothing is better than strengthened sympathy; to dispel obscuration, nothing is better than learning.' This method diagnoses the two root pathologies of cognition: mistaking the private for the public, and mistaking the obscured for the clear.
process_zh: 自查双重病灶：我的判断是被知识之蔽扭曲，还是被利益之私扭曲 → 对蔽：扩大学习面，接触对立观点，破除师心自用 → 对私：强恕——推己及人，检验主张在互换立场后是否仍成立 → 建立『不敢以己见为理』的谦抑性认知纪律
process_en: Self-audit the twin defects: is my judgment distorted by ignorance or by interest → for obscuration: widen learning, engage opposing views, break self-conceit → for self-interest: practice empathy, test whether one's claim survives position-swapping → adopt the discipline of never presuming one's own view is principle
modes.key_quote_zh: 人之患在私与蔽：去私莫如强恕，解蔽莫如学。
modes.key_quote_en: The human ailments are self-interest and obscuration: nothing removes self-interest better than empathy; nothing removes obscuration better than learning.
representative_cases_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·理》：「人之患在私与蔽：去私莫如强恕，解蔽莫如学。……」——解蔽去私法的典据来源
modern_applications_zh: 认知偏差与利益冲突的自觉排查
决策前的立场互换检验
学者与专家的谦抑性纪律
modern_applications_en: Conscious screening for cognitive bias and conflicts of interest
Position-swap tests before decisions
Disciplinary humility for scholars and experts

modes.name_en: Qi-Transformation as the Way Method (Dynamic Naturalism)
modes.definition_zh: 道，犹行也；气化流行，生生不息，是故谓之道。道不是超越气化之上的静态实体，而是气化过程本身——阴阳五行运行不息即道之实体。天地之气化流行不已，生生之德即在其中。此法以过程本体论取代实体本体论，反对朱熹「理在气先」的二元架构。
modes.definition_en: 'The Way is like moving (xing); qi flows and transforms, generating life without cease — this is called the Dao.' The Way is not a static entity transcending qi-transformation but the process of qi-transformation itself — the ceaseless operation of yin-yang and the five phases is the very substance of the Dao. This method replaces substance ontology with process ontology, opposing Zhu Xi's dichotomy of 'Principle before qi'.
process_zh: 把研究对象视为过程而非静物（道犹行也） → 追踪其内在的运行机制（气化）而非外在的主宰（理/神） → 在连续变化中把握生生不息的生成性 → 拒绝在过程之外另设第一因或超验实体
process_en: Treat the object of study as a process, not a static thing → trace its inner mechanism (qi-transformation), not an external governor → grasp generativity within continuous change → refuse to posit a first cause or transcendent entity outside the process
modes.key_quote_zh: 道犹行也；气化流行，生生不息，是故谓之道。
modes.key_quote_en: The Way is like movement: the flowing transformation of qi, generating life without cease—this is called the Way.
representative_cases_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·天道》/《绪言》：「道犹行也；气化流行，生生不息，是故谓之道。……」——气化即道法的典据来源
modern_applications_zh: 过程思维与动态系统分析
演化论视角下的组织与文化研究
反对本质主义僵化思维
modern_applications_en: Process thinking and dynamic systems analysis
Evolutionary study of organizations and culture
Against essentialist rigidity

modes.name_en: Empathic Weighing Method (Qing-Qing as the Source of Justice)
modes.definition_zh: 情之不爽失谓之理；以我之情絜人之情，而无不得其平是也。心所同然谓之理、谓之义：理义非他，所照所察者之不谬也。判断正当性不靠上位的抽象规范，而靠以己度人、推己及人的公平性检验——凡我之情与他人之情在换位后皆得其平者，即理义所在。
modes.definition_en: 'What does not err in feeling is called li; taking my own feeling to gauge another's feeling, and finding equity throughout — that is it.' What all minds agree upon is li and yi: Principle and rightness are nothing but what, when illuminated and examined, proves without error. Justification comes not from abstract superior norms but from the fairness test of putting oneself in another's place: whatever balances the feelings of all parties upon exchange of positions is where li lies.
process_zh: 取一件事，先述我方之情（欲望、损失、感受） → 以我之情絜人之情：模拟对方在同等处境之情 → 检视双方之情是否皆得其平——偏重任何一方即为不公 → 以换位平衡的结论为衡断，替代诉诸权威或抽象名义
process_en: Take a case; first state my own feelings (desires, losses, sentiments) → measure others' feelings against mine, simulating their state in the same situation → check whether both sides' feelings are balanced; one-sidedness is injustice → take the balanced conclusion as the verdict, replacing appeal to authority or abstract names
modes.key_quote_zh: 以我之情絜人之情，而无不得其平。
modes.key_quote_en: Weigh others' feelings with one's own as the measure, and equilibrium is found in every case.
representative_cases_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·理》：「以我之情絜人之情，而无不得其平。……」——挈情度理法的典据来源
modern_applications_zh: 调解与协商中的利益平衡技术
用户体验与人因设计中的换位测试
公平性评估的可操作化方法
modern_applications_en: Balancing techniques in mediation and negotiation
Empathy testing in UX and human factors design
Operationalizing fairness assessment

modes.definition_zh: 戴震治学：每一结论必有本证、旁证、反证三层检验，孤证不立；天文历算、地理沿革、音韵训诂诸科互参，多学科证据交叉锁定结论。辨《尚书》伪古文、正《方言》传讹，皆以实证驳成见。此法把「实事求是，无征不信」确立为学术铁律——不以权威、不以多数、不以成说，唯以证据。
modes.definition_en: Dai Zhen's scholarship tests every conclusion through three tiers of evidence — direct, corroborative, and counter-evidence; a single source never suffices. Astronomy, chronology, geography, phonology, and philology are cross-referenced so multiple disciplines converge to lock a conclusion. In exposing the forged 'Old Text' Documents and correcting corruptions in the Fangyan, empirical evidence always overrules received opinion. This method establishes 'seek truth from facts, believe nothing without evidence' as the iron law of scholarship.
modes.source_chapter: 《与姚孝廉姬传书》/《方言疏证》《考工记图》
process_zh: 列出结论所需证据链，标明每环的来源与强度 → 分置本证（直接）、旁证（间接）、反证（不利）三栏 → 引入其他学科的证据交叉验证（天文、地理、音韵等） → 孤证存疑、反证优先：凡有不利证据，结论必须修正或悬置
process_en: List the chain of evidence a conclusion needs, marking each link's source and strength → set direct evidence, indirect evidence, and counterevidence in separate columns → cross-validate with other disciplines (astronomy, geography, phonology) → suspect solitary evidence and prioritize counterevidence: revise or suspend conclusions when adverse evidence appears
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡学未至贯本末、彻精粗，徒以意衡量，终身不得闻道。
modes.key_quote_en: If learning has not reached through root and branch, fine and coarse, but relies on mere opinion, one will never in a lifetime hear the Way.
representative_cases_zh: 《与姚孝廉姬传书》/《方言疏证》《考工记图》：「凡学未至贯本末、彻精粗，徒以意衡量，终身不得闻道……」——证据递进考据法的典据来源
modern_applications_zh: 事实核查与信源分级
多源交叉验证的研究设计
对成见与权威断言的实证审查
modern_applications_en: Fact-checking and source grading
Multi-source cross-validation in research design
Empirical audit of prejudice and authoritative claims

modes.name_en: Learning as Disillusion Method (Self-Cultivation through Disciplined Inquiry)
modes.definition_zh: 戴震自述：仆自十七岁有志闻道，谓非求之六经孔孟不得，非从事于字义制度名物无由通其语言。读书一字之义当贯群经，本六书然后考定；日知其所亡，月无忘其所能。其一生贫病而学不辍，主张以持敬之心、精确之功，终身以学问解除生而之蔽，达于神明之圣。
modes.definition_en: Dai Zhen relates: 'At seventeen I set my will on reaching the Way, holding that it could only be sought in the Six Classics and Confucius-Mencius, and that without working through word-meanings, institutions, and names one cannot penetrate their language.' The meaning of a single character must run through all the classics; only via the six categories of script can a reading be settled — daily adding to what one knows, monthly never forgetting what one has mastered. Through a lifetime of study amid poverty and illness, disciplined reverence and meticulous precision dispel the obscuration we are born with, until the mind reaches illuminated clarity.
modes.source_chapter: 《孟子字义疏证·才》/《答郑丈用牧书》
process_zh: 确立终身问题（闻道）作为一切学习的统摄目标 → 把大目标分解为可日课的精确工序（字义、制度、名物、算学） → 以贯通检验局部：一字之义必贯群经方为定论 → 日积月累、贫病不辍，以纪律将心知扩充至神明
process_en: Fix a lifelong question (hearing the Way) as the goal governing all study → decompose it into daily precise routines (word meanings, institutions, names, mathematics) → test the part against the whole: a single character's meaning is settled only when it accords across the classics → accumulate day by day, undeterred by poverty or illness, expanding knowing into clarity by discipline
modes.key_quote_zh: 仆自十七岁以来，有志闻道，谓非求之六经孔孟不得，非从事于字义制度名物，无由以通其语言。
modes.key_quote_en: Since seventeen I have aspired to hear the Way; it cannot be sought except in the Six Classics and Confucius and Mencius, and their language cannot be mastered except through the study of word meanings, institutions, and names of things.
representative_cases_zh: 《孟子字义疏证·才》/《答郑丈用牧书》：「仆自十七岁以来，有志闻道，谓非求之六经孔孟不得，……」——学以去蔽·主敬精审法的典据来源
modern_applications_zh: 长期主义的知识积累策略
以日课纪律对抗认知懈怠
跨学科贯通式的问题驱动学习
modern_applications_en: Long-termist knowledge accumulation
Daily-routine discipline against cognitive slack
Cross-disciplinary, question-driven learning
